How patients choose a practice now

Patients decide before they call.

We make sure your practice is the one they trust at every step, from the first search to the booked appointment.

  1. 01Search

    Patients search the service they need and add “near me.”

  2. 02Maps

    They compare the practices Google shows close by.

  3. 03Reviews

    They read what other patients say, and how you reply.

  4. 04AI answers

    More of them now ask ChatGPT or Google’s AI which practice to see.

  5. 05Booked

    They call or book with the practice they trust most.

How practices rank on Google Maps

Where you show up depends on where the patient is standing.

A practice can be first in Maps a block away and invisible a mile out. Google says local results come down to three things, and patients add a fourth: trust.

  • RelevanceHow well your profile matches what the patient searched.
  • DistanceHow far the patient is from your practice.
  • ProminenceHow well known your practice is, including your reviews and rating.
  • TrustRecent reviews, real photos, accurate hours and clear provider pages.
Source: Google Business Profile Help, “Tips to improve your local ranking”

How we start

From first call to first report.

01 Visibility checkWe search the way your patients do, on Google Search, Google Maps and AI assistants, and record where you show up and where competitors do instead.
02 PlanYou get a written plan that lists the gaps in order of impact, what we will do about each one, and what we will not touch.
03 ReportingWe report against the baseline from the visibility check, in plain language, so you can see what moved and what did not.
Do you write medical advice or clinical content?

No. We write about your practice, services, providers and how to book. Clinical statements come from your team, and we ask a clinician to approve them before anything is published.

How do you handle patient privacy in reviews?

Replies stay general. We do not confirm that a reviewer is a patient or mention any care details, and we flag reviews that need a response from your office instead.

Can you work with multiple locations?

Yes. Each location gets its own profile checks and reporting, with one plan across the group.

Do you work with dental, med spa and specialty practices?

Yes. The approach is the same for any practice patients search for locally. We adjust the services, keywords and content to your specialty and the way your patients describe what they need.

Will you need access to patient records?

No. We never need patient records or protected health information. We work with your public profiles, website and approved content, and anything sensitive stays with your office.

How soon will we see a difference?

It depends on your market and where you start. We record a baseline in the first month and report every week, so you can see what is moving and what is not.
